questions.q: According to the video, what happens to acceleration when you push harder on a box?
questions.why: The video says bigger force gives bigger acceleration.

questions.q: A force of 10 N pushes a 2 kg object. What is its acceleration?
questions.why: The example gives a = F / m = 10 N / 2 kg = 5 m/s².

questions.q: You double the push on the same object. What happens to its acceleration?
questions.why: The video states that 2F gives 2a on the same object.
